title: Architecture Decision Records & Tradeoffs
objectives: Write a lightweight ADR: context, options, decision, consequences
Compare options with an explicit tradeoff table

examples.name: adr-template.md
examples.code:
# ADR-NNN: <title>

## Context
What forces are in play?

## Options
1. ...
2. ...

## Decision
Chosen option + one-line rationale.

## Consequences
+ gains
- costs / mitigations

exercise.prompt: Order the decision pipeline correctly: decision, problem, options, measurement, constraints, tradeoffs. Render the correct order.
hints: It starts with the problem, ends with measuring the decision.
Constraints come before options — they prune the option space.

questions.prompt: When a decision changes, the ADR convention is…
options: edit the old ADR in place
write a new ADR that supersedes the old one
questions.explanation: ADRs are immutable history; supersession preserves the reasoning trail.

questions.prompt: Which decision deserves the most ADR rigor?
questions.explanation: One-way-door, expensive-to-reverse decisions justify recorded tradeoff analysis.
